 DELTA CENTAURI DEVELOPMENTS (PRIVATE) LIMITED , a company registered under the laws of Pakistan with its registered office located at 94-B/1, Pearl One, MM Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore ( “ LESSEE ” which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART .

 WHEREAS 
 
 The Lessee is a real estate developer, and has undertaken a real estate project named and styled as ‘ DOWN TOWN RUMANZA ’ comprising of inter alia residential apartments, service apartments, shops, hotel apartments and food courts located at Plot No. RC- 01, Near Rumanza Golf Course, DHA Multan (“ Project ”) ; 
 
 The Lessor is the sole, absolute and exclusive owner of a hotel apartment in ‘ DOWN TOWN RUMANZA ’ , purchased by the Lessor from the Lessee vide Agreement to Sell No. _______________ dated ________ executed by and between the Parties for sale and leaseback of the hotel apartment ; and 
 
 Pursuant to the terms and conditions of the aforementioned Agreement to Sell, the Lessor desires to lease back to the Lessee, and the Lessee desires to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Lease back Agreement . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , Lessor and Lessee, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 Th e Leaseback Agreement (defined below) , along with the Agreement to Sell as well as all annexures attached thereto, and any other document ( s ) forming part of the Leaseback Agreement pursuant to the term and conditions hereof , shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parti es hereto in respect of the lease back of the Demised Premises (defined below) . 
 
 The documents specified in Clause 1 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions attached to the Agreement to Sell , followed by the Agreement to Sell , and D escription of the Unit attached to the Agreement to Sell . Any terms used as defined terms and not defined in the Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to them in the Agreement to Sell . The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Lease back Agreement. 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPREATION 
 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell executed by and between the Lessor and the Lessee for the sale and leaseback of the Demised Premises, as specified in Recital (B) of th is Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any U nit including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Demised Premises and do not form part of any given Unit . 
 
 Commencement Date means the date on which the Hotel Management Company launches the hotel for the Project, in accordance with the Permitted Use. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority including the Office of the Defence Housing Authority, Lahore- Multan Chapter , and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or th is Lease back Agreement. 
 
 Complimentary Voucher means a voucher for one night’s free stay at the Demised Premises or a comparable hotel apartment/Unit in the Project , as specified in Clause 7 whereas Complimentary Vouchers means multiple. 
 
 Demised Premises means the U nit purchased through the Agreement to Sell which the Lessee leases through this Lease back Agreement , as more fully described in Description of Unit/Demised Premises ap pended to the Agreement to Sell . For the avoidance of doubt, any reference to the Demised Premises , where the context so permits, shall also be reference to the Unit as defined under Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Due Date means the date on which any payment of R ent (defined below) is required to be paid by the Lessee to the Lessor in the designated bank account in accordance with this Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3 5 an d 3 6 . 
 
 Expiry Date means the date of expiry or termination of the Lease Period in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 Hotel Management Company 
 means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the maintenance, operation or management of a hotel with respect to the Units, including the Demised Premises, and the Parking Area, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Lease Period has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 5. 
 
 Leaseback Agreement means this Leaseback Agreement entered into by and between the Lessor and Lessee for the leaseback of the Demised Premises , as more fully described in Clause 1 . 
 
 Nominee has the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Party means the Lessee or the Lessor, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Permitted Use has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 9 of th is Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Project means the real estate project , named and styled as ‘ Down Town Rumanza ’, being constructed and developed by the Developer on RC-01, Near Rumanza Golf Course, DHA Multan . 
 
 Purchase Price shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rent means the annual rent payable by the Lessee to Lessor for leaseback of the Demised Premises as specified in Clause 6 of th is Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 Unit means a ny one or more hotel apartment (s) in the Project , including Unit .

 Any term not defined in th is Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 TERM OF LEASE 
 
 The Lessor hereby agrees to irrevocably leaseback , and the Lessee hereby agrees to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises for an initial duration and lock-in period of [●] years which may be renewed in accordance with Clause 3 2 hereof (the “ Lease Period ”). The Lease Period shall commence on the Commencement Date. 
 
 RENT 
 
 In consideration of the lease of the Demised Premises, the Lessee shall pay Rent and other benefits to the Lessor during the Lease Period on the following terms: 
 
 Monthly Rent shall be paid on a pro-rated basis calculated at [●%] of the Purchase Price of the Demised Premises per annum . 
 
 Rent shall be increased by [●%] every three years of the Lease Period. 
 
 Rent shall be paid for eleven (11) months per year of the Lease Period , along with thirty (30) C omplimentary Vouchers . The Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor in accordance with Clause 7 of th is Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 COMPLIMENTARY VOUCHERS 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor as per the following terms : 
 
 A maximum of fifteen (15) Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed during peak season, and fifteen (15) during off-peak season , subject to availability and confirmation by the Hotel Management Company . 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed by the Lessor, either her/himself or for friends and family ( the “Beneficiary”), subject to availability. The Beneficiary shall have access to all Common F acilities and amenities of fered by the Hotel Management Company during their stay , as per the rules and regulations of the Hotel Management Company, and any additional services may be availed as per the standard schedule of rates &amp; charges specified by the Hotel Management Company. 
 
 The Lessor may , at Lessor’s option, encash all thirty (30) Complimentary Vouchers in exchange for one month’s Rent. For the avoidance of doubt, one month ’s R ent under this Clause 7 (iii) shall only be claimed against thirty ( 30 ) unredeemed and valid Complimentary Vouchers . 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers shall be valid for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of issuance thereof and, if not redeemed or encashed during the validity period, shall not be carried forward for any further period. 
 
 OTHER CHARGES 
 
 All applicable taxes shall be borne and paid by the Parties in accordance with law. 
 
 
 PERMITTED USE 
 
 The Lessee will use , occupy , sub-lease the Demised Premises for the purpose of operating, managing and maintaining a h otel, either itself or through a Hotel Management Company, for the duration of the Lease Period. 
 
 The Lessee will comply with all applicable laws, ordinances, rules, orders, and regulations of any Competent Authority with respect to the Demised Premises and Permitted Use . 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Lessor shall only sell / transfer or assign the Demised Premises in accordance with the Agreement to Sell and the Rules, provided that the transferee has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by this Agreement and has signed a letter of adherence or such other document as may be prescribed in this regard. 
 
 The Lessee shall have the right to sublease all or any part of the Demised Premises during the Lease Period at the Lessee’s own discretion , and the Lessor hereby undertakes to do or cause to be done all such acts , deeds and the things and execute any documents required in relation or ancillary thereto. Provided that any such sublease shall be subject to the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the Lessee’s obligation for payment of Rent hereunder. 
 
 L ESSOR’S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessor permits the Lessee to carry out any required internal partitions, modifications, or to dismantle or make alteration(s) to the Demised Premises , and install any billboards, hoardings, signage or any other promotional material as it deems fit for the Permitted Use . The Lessee shall also have the right to place and install on the Demised Premises specific outlets and adequate equipment, including inter alia equipment for central air-conditioning (if any). Lessee shall not be liable to remove, at the time of expiry or termination of th is Lease back Agreement, any fixtures and fittings or to reverse alterations as made by the Lessee during the Lease Period . 
 
 The Lessor hereby represents and warrants that at the time of execution of this Leaseback Agreement , the Demised Premises is free from any lien, charge, encumbrance, etc. of whatsoever nature, and that the Demised Premises shall remain unencumbered throughout the Lease Period . 
 
 The Lessor shall not cause the Demised Premise s to become subject to any lien, charge or encumbrance whatsoever. 
 
 The Lessor hereby undertake s that Lessee shall enjoy quiet and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises from the date of signing of this Leaseback Agreement and during the Lease Period, without any hindrance or disturbance . 
 
 The Lessor shall not hinder in any way the Lessee’s right to manage the Demised Premises as it deems fit, including the determination by the Hotel Management Company of the schedule of rates and charges for the hotel, managing occupancy, day to day operations, human resource and other aspects associated with the Permitted Use. 
 
 LESSEE’S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessee shall regularly and promptly pay the agreed Rent on a monthly basis, along with thirty (30) Complimentary Vouchers, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 The Lessee shall , at its own cost, repair and maintain the Demised Premises, including all fixtures and fittings therein, and shall ensure that the Demised Premises free of any defects and maintained in a good tenantable con dition, during the Lease Period, subject to the provisions of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 The Lessee shall regularly and promptly pay all utility bills and other related charges during the Lease Period . 
 
 WARRANTIES 
 The Lessor confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the provisions of this Leaseback Agreement and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Lessee. 
 
 The Lessor confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Lessor herein are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Lessor confirms and warrants that the Lessor (and where there is more than one Lessor , each such Lessor ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Leaseback Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 The Lessor represents that it has good, valid, legal and subsisting title to the Demised Premises and is fully authorized to leaseback the Demised Premises. 
 
 The Lessor undertakes that the Lessor shall not terminate this Leaseback Agreement during the lock-in period specified in Clause 5 above. 
 
 The Lessor warrants not to lease, assign, mortgage, encumber or otherwise hypothecate any interest in the Demised Premises other than in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 The Lessor shall ensure that the Lessee enjoy quiet and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises during the Lease Period without any let or hindrance by the Lessor or any person claiming under or in trust for the Lessor. 
 
 The Lessor hereby covenants that grant of this leaseback is in compliance with the conditions of Agreement to Sell. 
 
 EVENTS OF DEFAULT 
 
 Subject to the terms of this Agreement, in the event that the Lessee fails to pay the due Rent on the [●] day of every month, the Lessee shall pay the Lessor a monthly fee until such time as the Rent is paid by the Developer to the Buyer. The monthly fee shall be calculated on a pro-rata basis and shall be equal to [●%] per annum of the total payments received from the Buyer to date with respect to the Purchase Price. 
 
 I n the event that the Lessee fails to pay Rent for a period of six (6 ) months consecutively, then the Less ee shall do or cause to be done all acts necessary for the rights of the Lessor in the Demised Premises to be recorded in the relevant land registry. 
 
 In the event of breach of its obligations hereunder by the Lessor , the Lessee shall be at liberty for recourse and r edressal in the terms of th is Leaseback Agreement against the Lessor (as the Lessee may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 RENEWAL AND TERMINATION 
 
 Upon lapse of the initial lock-in period of [●] years, the Lease Period may be renewed for a further period of [●] years upon written mutual consent of the Parties and on the same terms and conditions as this Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 T his Lease back Agreement may be terminated upon written mutual consent of both Parties . 
 
 In the event of termination of this Leaseback Agreement, the Lessee shall hand over peaceful and vacant possession of the Demised Premises to the Lessor. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means any event or occurrence beyond the control of the Developer (including but not limited to any injunction/stay order, government notification, spread of infectious disease on Project site) that prevents the Developer from completing or performing its obligations under the Agreement. The Developer shall not be liable for such non-completion or non-performance under the Agreement for so long as such Event of Force Majeure exists and its effects continue. 
 
 Should an Event of Force Majeure occur that is likely to or will delay the Commencement Date, the Lessee shall promptly notify the Lessor of the event and give the Lessor a revised Commencement Date or an estimate of the duration of the delay, followed by a revised Commencement Date as and when it can be determined. 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The Leaseback Agreement, as defined in Clause 1 , constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and overrides, supersedes, cancels any  other negotiations, commitments, discussions, representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, with respect to the leaseback of the Demised Premises, whether made by the Lesse e , any agent, employee or representative of the Lessee or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, show room displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Lessor or made available for his/her viewing and, upon acceptance by the Lessee , th is Leaseback Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject to the terms and conditions contained herein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in th is Leaseback Agreement, any modification or amendment to th is Leaseback Agreement shall be in writing and expressly stating the intention to modify, amend or waive any provision of th is Leaseback Agreement, duly signed by both Parties. 
 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 The Leaseback Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to th is Leaseback Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan and subject to clause 40 , the Courts at Lahore shall have exclusive jurisdiction . 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to th is Leaseback Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act 1940. After lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one each to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator (s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 NOTICES 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under this Leaseback Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty -eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in th is Leaseback Agreement or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. 
 
 It is clarified that in case there is more than one Lessor , notice to any one Lessor shall be deemed as notice to all Lessors and the Lessee shall be under no obligation to write to each Lessor individually. 
 
 Lessor shall notify the Lessee in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Lessor’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Lessee to the Lessor at the last known address. 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and any documents, data, notices or information disclosed or shared by the Lessee, oral or written, shall be regarded as confidential information by the Lessor and the Lessor shall take all reasonable measures to maintain the confidentiality of all such confidential information and shall not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties, except where such disclosure is required under any law or court order. This clause shall survive the termination or expiry of this Agreement. 
 
 S URVIVAL 
 The Leaseback Agreement shall en s ure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assignees. 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 The Leaseback Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 WAIVER 
 The delay or failure of either Party to enforce or insist upon strict compliance with any of the terms or conditions of th is Lease back Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of said Party’s rights hereunder. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 If any one or more provisions of th is Leaseback Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 
 GOOD FAITH 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under th is Leaseback Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 The Lessor hereby confirms having read and understood th is Leaseback Agreement in its entirety, and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
